text: Hey Maya! So, rooftop drinks on Congress last night. How'd it go? Give me the honest version.
Honestly? Better than I expected, but not for the reasons I thought.
Ooh, okay, I need details. Let's start with Ethan. How was talking to him?
Ethan was fine. Super polished. But he talked about his deal for like forty minutes and I kind of zoned out. I don't need to see him again.
Ha, noted. No more deal talk. What about Marcus?
Marcus was nice, really smart. But it felt more like a networking thing than a date thing. Maybe as a friend.
Got it. And Jordan, the sound engineer?

Okay, Jordan was the surprise. He's not my usual type at all. We ended up talking about hiking the Greenbelt for an hour, and he told me about his band. I was laughing the whole time. I'd totally see him again.
I love that. So the guy who isn't your 'type' was the highlight. What do you think it was?

I think I liked that he was excited about stuff that wasn't work. I say I want ambitious, but I actually want someone who has a life outside their job. And I miss being outside. I used to hike all the time.
That's a really good insight. How about Priya and Claire?
Priya was great, we're already planning to play tennis. Claire was sweet, but we didn't really connect.
A tennis friend, love it. Last one: anything you'd change about next week's Plan?
Maybe less of a scene? The rooftop was loud. Something where you can actually talk, or do something.
Totally. I've got a really good picture now. Thanks, Maya. I'll put together next week's Plan.
